title: East Kelowna Half Day Wine Tour- Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Grat!
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Kelowna
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready to uncork some fun on the Kelowna Wine Tour, where you can explore some of the oldest and most historic wineries in British Columbia! Hop on the Half Day Sip Disturber for an unforgettable afternoon of tastings at four award-winning vineyards, sampling up to 20 delicious wines along the way. Just a short drive from downtown, you’ll cruise through the scenic orchards of East Kelowna and soak in breathtaking views of the Lakeshore, all while discovering a wine region rich in history. Cheers to a sip-disturbing good time!
